text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —I heard you enjoy coffee as well, Journey-san, so I have prepared some. Would you prefer black tea or coffee?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Since you're offering, I'll take the coffee—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
What will you be doing, Trainer?

"...The reason Dream Journey and I were receiving
such hospitality from the Mejiro family
goes back a little while—"

The letter Mejiro McQueen brought to Dream Journey the other day.
Its sender was none other than "Anego", but—
choice_data_list: …So what the heck was it about?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —"Try relying on the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...To summarize, that is the essence of it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It appears Big Sis has secretly been
watching over my journey...
I think that's wonderful news. But on the other hand, why did Stay Gold suddenly make such a proposal? A great mystery lay right before me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Let's go pay a visit to the Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Considering McQueen's parting words,
she most likely knows what's in the letter too—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Why did Ane-go tell me to rely on the Mejiro family? Why was McQueen-san holding onto Ane-go's letter...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If you ask them directly,
I'm sure they will answer everything for you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
――...What sort of relationship
do you and McQueen-san have?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that is true.
If I dared to sum it up in one word—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A “comrade”, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Comrade—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, back when she was running
at the very forefront of the Twinkle Series—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There was a time when I personally helped her with her training, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You were playfully calling it 'Stealth McQueen Special Training'... among other things, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...As for how it turned out this way...
If I try to put it into words, there are so many twists and turns
that the explanation itself would be a journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, what matters is... that she sought strength, and devoted herself to training alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "And the belief she holds, shining like pure gold—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To "continue the 'journey' for as long as possible as a racing Umamusume" was something that struck a personal chord with her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me for saying so, but I've secretly been following all your races up until now, Journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...You foresee your own future growth,
as well as the strength of the rivals yet to come, and worry over it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"In other words—
'At this rate, we won't be able to continue the "journey".'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Isn't that what's troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...Just as expected. So you saw right through it, did you?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However... this clears up one thing
about Big Sis's behavior.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Were you facing your past as well, Big Sis?
The very same thing?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Coincidentally, that was also right before
she herself was to challenge the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And together with McQueen-san, I honed my skills.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: In order to obtain the "strength to continue the journey"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
......Shall we change locations?
I'll explain the rest along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ――... The power she honed alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Above all else...
It lay in her "tenacity" on the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“—We of the Mejiro family hold an especially deep devotion
toward winning long-distance GⅠ races,
beginning with the Tenno Sho (Spring).”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I take immense pride in the tactical, physical,
and mental know-how we have cultivated over time
to contest long, grueling races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...She absorbed all of it like water poured onto parched sand,
turning it into fuel to see her through that long journey."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure they just had great chemistry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My... the Mejiro family's way, and the way she chooses to be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"—This is one of our family's training courses,
which that person also used for special training."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Right now...
it isn't used much in our family anymore, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...As two who run in the present, you surely know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That our Mejiro family is currently in a slump.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Placing emphasis on long-distance races and
making high stamina the core foundation—
the traditional Mejiro tactic."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Before long...
they became unable to adapt to the mainstream of the new era,
such as faster race paces."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"And while I feel some slight hesitation
putting this into words..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Reflecting the shifting trends in racing, there has been a tendency in the public eye to place somewhat less value on long-distance GⅠ races compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course, that victory still remains an unexpected honor, nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However... when viewed as a standard of strength,
the meaning it carries has changed from the past—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...With all these circumstances coming together,
our family has ended up in its current state.

"...The shift in racing trends.
And along with it, the change in the value of long-distance GⅠ races."

Everything Mejiro McQueen talked about resonated deeply with me as a Trainer.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—However, even now, you all still hold
pride in belonging to the Mejiro family.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And... it is also true that the Mejiro family
still possesses vast expertise when it comes to long distances.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
May I have your permission right here on the spot?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Just as Sis once did, I too shall ask for Ms. McQueen's assistance.

I nod in response.
This is a path forward for Dream Journey,
brought about by the ties forged through Stay Gold.
A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to run the tough races beyond the Kikuka-sho, to continue Dream Journey's 'journey'—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Of course, this is all assuming it is agreeable to McQueen-san and the rest of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Don't you think it's a bit late for that, after coming all this way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If anything—
we are the ones who wish to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —We of the Mejiro family shall pass down our techniques, our will, and everything we can bestow upon you all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "With that in mind, I would like you to 'prove' it through your future runs."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The strength of the Mejiro family. Our pride. Our very existence.
Every single part of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Will you accept the request,
Dream Journey?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —I shall humbly accept.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And I will surely prove it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "I swear upon the golden bond that brought about this encounter."
"And so, a new pact was forged between Dream Journey and the Mejiro family—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Impressive.
To think you would latch on this quickly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. To think you'd say that about what just happened...
You really are kind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind if you trampled all over me even more.
To the point where it bores you, even.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That way...
it'll serve as better nourishment for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It seems your running speaks much more clearly than your words as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "The yearning brewing deep within her is both reassuring... and terrifying."
Dream Journey underwent intense training with Mejiro McQueen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Physician
text_block_list.text: "As you can see, in long-distance races, the precision of recovery immediately following the race directly impacts how quickly one recovers afterward."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Physician
text_block_list.text:
The ratio of fast-twitch to slow-twitch muscle fibers
also affects this recovery rate, so please remain mindful
of your body composition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Here is Lady McQueen's data from around
the Kikuka Sho and Tenno Sho (Spring).
Please take what we just discussed into account when referencing it.

"As for me, I had been learning from the Mejiro family staff,
absorbing all the wealth of experience they had accumulated—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —McQueen-san truly is a terrifying Umamusume, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The strength of will dwelling within her
is truly a brilliance that embodies the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Just how much havoc on the turf the running of
the one hailed as the greatest stayer in history once wreaked.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Being able to experience a glimpse of that firsthand
was truly... an invaluable experience.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Just remembering running alongside her
makes me shudder.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah, how utterly pathetic of me—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed.
Fateful connections have a way of bearing fruit in unexpected ways."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Let's make sure to carry this legacy on properly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Her pride, their pride.
Carrying it all forward onto our "journey."

And after that, special training
at the Mejiro estate continued on—
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for taking care of me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I feel I was able to
learn a great deal for the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We are the ones who should be thanking you.
Thanks to all of you, a fire has been lit within us once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family intends to continue
supporting you two even after you return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, allow me to see
your "journey" through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I am honored.
...I shall certainly show you."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Our "journey."
What lies at the end of it—

Summer draws near,
along with the scent of the tide.
